'''Rovair Kirklin''' is [[Warder]] to [[Masuri Sokawa]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is compact with dark hair that is receding.

== Activities ==
He travels with Masuri to [[Ghealdan]]. He is furious with the way the [[Aiel]] [[Wise Ones]] treat Masuri.
When [[Faile Bashere]] is captured by the [[Shaido]] Aiel, he travels with [[Elyas Machera]] to find her tracks.

He accompanies Masuri when she begins to meet with Masema by herself.
He accompanies [[Perrin Aybara]] and Masuri to [[So Habor]], where he sticks close to her when the residents claim to be seeing ghosts.

He goes through the aqueduct to enter the town of [[Malden]] before Perrin begins his attack. Once Faile is found he rushes back to where Masuri is during the [[Battle of Malden]].
